program_stop_triggers: If ETF holdings/flows and central-bank demand cannot be acquired with usable lag timestamps, stop the full macro-regime thesis instead of substituting another reduced-scope rescue.
If broker/spot alignment cannot be established before commercialization, do not convert COMEX proxy results into broker XAUUSD claims.
If full-scope lag-safe preflight fails after source acquisition, stop or redesign at the thesis level only; do not tune Stage64H reduced-scope rules.
No intraday scan, no parameter rescue, and no order path are allowed from Stage64J.
